coordinate_convention: Image pixels top-left; Three equirectUv atan(z,x)/(2*pi)+0.5, asin(y)/pi+0.5 with image upload flipY=true

starting_exposure.ldr_background: Already tonemapped sRGB: sample to linear once and bypass second filmic tonemap or compensate separately. Keep exposure1 for the provider LDR.
starting_exposure.status: Integration starting values, not rendered acceptance.

rotation_contract: If sampling u += yaw/(2*pi), sun world azimuth becomes native azimuth minus yaw. Rotate direct-light direction by the same inverse lookup yaw. For a rotated sphere instead, rotate the sun vector by the sphere world rotation.
